string.text: Find the Basic Toolkit
With this toolkit, the Flea Market technician will have enough tools to start performing upgrades for weapons and armor.
Find the Advanced Toolkit
With this toolkit, Limpid will have tools detailed enough to do better upgrades for weapons and armor.
Find the Expert Toolkit
With this toolkit, Limpid will have tools fine enough to do virtually any upgrades for weapons and armor.
Find the Flash Drive: SEVA
With this Flash Drive, Limpid will have all the information on how to modify a closed circuit protection suit
Find the Flash Drive: Exoskeleton
With this Flash Drive, Limpid will have all the information on how to modify the support systems on the exoskeleton
Find the Flash Drive: GP37
With this Flash Drive, Limpid will have all the information on how to modify a GP37 assault rifle
Find the Flash Drive: Tunder
With this Flash Drive, Limpid will have information on how to adjust the internal mechanics of the Tunder assault rifle.
Find the Flash Drive: Military Body Armour
With this Flash Drive, Limpid will have information on how to add Military type body armor to an armored suit
Find the Flash Drive: Shotgun Strikers
With this Flash Drive, Limpid will have information on how to modify the internal strikers of both automatic and semi automatic shotguns
Deliver medical supplies
The Bandit gang is in urgent need of advanced medical supplies
Deliver Vodka
The Bandit gang requires some vodka to help them relax a bit
Deliver Weapon and ammo
The Bandit gang requires a new combat shotgun and ammo for one of it's members
